description: Screenshot of Q post No.5224931 (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, 02/17/19) on 8chan with dozens of reply links. It embeds a July 2015 U.S. map GIF (DL_Map_July2015.gif) shading states that offer driving privileges to unauthorized immigrants (e.g. Washington, California, Nevada, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, Illinois, Vermont, and others in brown) versus states that do not (green). The post links a tweet and claims that Democrats push driver's licenses for illegal immigrants to make voting easier, asking readers to compare such states to 2016 election results; these are the post's claims. Legend text on the map is too small to read fully.
